meta.name: ACME A3 server cluster 2026Q3 (project workflow)
meta.description: 48 nodes × (8 NPUs + 4 CPUs + 7 L1 UB chips), 12 compute + 4 communication cabinets, 7 sub-planes × 16 L2 chips; RDMA plane between supernodes (2 ports per NPU). Fault types per hardware unit: the audited catalog converted under the CloudMatrix384 geometry (FIT per unit = FIT per card × cards per unit); RoCE switches and links carry the UB analogues.
